1.text: Mwana wanjye, komeza amagambo yanjye,Kandi amategeko yanjye uyizirike.

2.text: Komeza amategeko yanjye ukunde ubeho,N'ibyigisho byanjye ubirinde nk'imboni y'ijisho ryawe.

3.text: Ubihambire ku ntoki zawe,Ubyandike ku nkingi z'umutima wawe.

4.text: Ubwire Bwenge uti “Uri mushiki wanjye”,N'ubuhanga ubwite incuti yawe.

5.text: Kugira ngo bikurinde umugore w'inzanduka,N'umunyamahangakazi ushyeshyengesha amagambo ye.

6.text: Nari mpagaze ku tubambano tw'idirishya ry'inzu yanjye ndunguruka,

7.text: Nuko ndeba mu baswa,Nitegereje mu basore,Mbona umusore utagira umutima,

8.text: Anyura mu nzira ikikiye ikibero cy'inzu ya maraya,Nuko ayembayemba ajya ku nzu ye,

9.text: Ari mu kabwibwi bugorobye,Ageza mu mwijima w'igicuku.

10.text: Maze umugore aramusanganira,Yambaye imyambaro y'abamaraya,Kandi afite umutima w'ubucakura.

11.text: Ni umugore usamara kandi ntiyifata,Ibirenge bye ntibiregama mu nzu ye.

12.text: Rimwe aba ari mu mayira ubundi aba ari mu maguriro,Kandi ategera mu mahuriro y'inzira yose.

13.text: Nuko aramufata aramusoma,Avugana na we adafite imbebya ati

14.text: “Mfite ibitambo by'uko ndi amahoro,Uyu munsi nahiguye imihigo yanjye.

15.text: Ni cyo gitumye nza kugusanganira,Nshaka cyane kureba mu maso hawe, none ndakubonye.

16.text: Uburiri bwanjye nabushasheho ibidarafu byoroshye,Bidozweho amabara y'ubudodo bwo muri Egiputa.

17.text: Uburiri bwanjye nabuminjagiyeho ibihumura neza,Ishangi n'umusagavu na mudarasini.

18.text: Ngwino dusohoze urukundo rwacu tugeze mu gitondo,Twinezeze mu by'urukundo.

19.text: Kuko umugabo wanjye atari imuhira,Yazindukiye mu rugendo rwa kure.

20.text: Yajyanye uruhago rw'impiya,Kandi azagaruka mu mboneko z'ukwezi gutaha.”

21.text: Nuko amushukisha akarimi ke kareshya,Amukuruza kuryarya k'ururimi rwe.

22.text: Aherako aramukurikira,Nk'ikimasa kigiye kubagwa,Cyangwa nk'umusazi uboshywe ajya guhanwa.

23.text: Kugeza ubwo umwambi uhinguranya umwijima we,Ameze nk'inyoni yihutira kugwa mu mutego,Itazi ko yategewe ubugingo bwayo.

24.text: None rero bahungu banjye muntegere amatwi,Kandi mwitondere amagambo ava mu kanwa kanjye.

25.text: Ntukunde ko umutima wawe utanyukira mu nzira ze,Ntukayobere mu migenzereze ye.

26.text: Kuko yagushije benshi abakomeretsa,Ni ukuri, abo yishe ni umutwe w'ingabo munini.

27.text: Inzu ye ni inzira igana ikuzimu,Imanuka ijya mu buturo bw'urupfu.
